inits_guide.Title: EXOTIC's Initialization File
inits_guide.Comment: Please answer all the following requirements below by following the format of the given
inits_guide.Comment1: sample dataset HAT-P-32 b. Edit this file as needed to match the data wanting to be reduced.
inits_guide.Comment2: Do not delete areas where there are quotation marks, commas, and brackets.
inits_guide.Comment3: The inits_guide dictionary (these lines of text) does not have to be edited
inits_guide.Comment4: and is only here to serve as a guide. Will be updated per user's advice.
inits_guide.Image Calibrations Directory Guide: Enter in the path to image calibrations or enter in null for none.
inits_guide.Planetary Parameters Guide: For planetary parameters that are not filled in, enter in null.
inits_guide.Comparison Star(s) Guide: Up to 10 comparison stars can be added following the format given below.
inits_guide.Obs. Latitude Guide: Indicate the sign (+ North, - South) before the degrees. Needs to be in decimal or HH:MM:SS format.
inits_guide.Obs. Longitude Guide: Indicate the sign (+ East, - West) before the degrees. Needs to be in decimal or HH:MM:SS format.
inits_guide.Camera Type (1): If you are using a CMOS, please enter CCD in 'Camera Type (CCD or DSLR)' and then note
inits_guide.Camera Type (2): your actual camera type under 'Observing Notes'.
inits_guide.Observatory Full Title: Optional full observatory name. If present, EXOTIC writes it to AAVSO output as OBSNAME.
inits_guide.Plate Solution: For your image to be given a plate solution, type y.
inits_guide.Plate Solution Disclaimer: One of your imaging files will be publicly viewable on nova.astrometry.net.
inits_guide.Standard Filter: To use EXOTIC standard filters, type only the filter name.
inits_guide.Custom Filter: To use a custom filter, enter in the FWHM in optional_info.
inits_guide.Target Star RA: Must be in HH:MM:SS sexagesimal format.
inits_guide.Target Star DEC: Must be in +/-DD:MM:SS sexagesimal format with correct sign at the beginning (+ or -).
inits_guide.Demosaic Format: Optional control for handling Bayer pattern color images - to use, provide Bayer color patttern of your camera (RGGB, BGGR, GRBG, GBRG) - null (no color processing) is default
inits_guide.Demosaic Output: Select how to process color data (gray for grayscale, red or green or blue for single color channel, blueblock for grayscale without blue, [ R, G, B ] for custom weights for mixing colors.  green is default
inits_guide.Fast Aperture Mask: Default false/exact mode for fractional-pixel aperture photometry. Set optional_info 'Fast Aperture Mask (y/n)' to true to opt into center-based masks for speed.
inits_guide.Ignore Header WCS: Set optional_info 'Ignore WCS in Header and Do Manual Alignment? (y/n)' to y to ignore FITS header WCS and force legacy image-to-image alignment. Default n.
inits_guide.Bad WCS Threshold Percent: Set optional_info 'bad_wcs_threshold_percent' to the maximum percent of images allowed to lack celestial WCS before EXOTIC keeps them and falls back to legacy alignment. If the missing-WCS fraction is below this threshold, those images are dropped. Default 3.
inits_guide.Pointing Rejection Sigma: Set optional_info 'pointing_rejection_sigma' to a positive sigma threshold to reject frames whose WCS-derived or alignment-derived pointings are strong outliers from the dataset median pointing before photometry. Set to 0 to disable. Default 4.
inits_guide.Vertical Flux Normalization: Set optional_info 'disable vertical flux normalization' to true to disable the default a0 baseline bound of [0.95, 1.05]. Default false.
inits_guide.Detect Bad Pixels Before Photometry: Set optional_info 'detect_bad_pixels_before_photometry' to y to scan the frame stack for persistent isolated high-count bad pixels before plate-solve checks and photometry, save the detection count image and mask into temp/, and median-8 repair those pixels before centroiding and photometry. Default y.
inits_guide.Out-of-Transit Baseline Detrending: Set optional_info 'detrend_on_outoftransit_baseline' to true to run a second-pass final fit after dividing out a weighted linear trend fit only to the modeled out-of-transit baseline before ingress and after egress. Default true.
inits_guide.Final Fit Baseline Duration Multiplier: Set optional_info 'final_fit_baseline_duration_multiplier' to the number of fitted transit durations to keep as baseline before ingress and after egress during the automatic final-fit prefit/refit. Default 1.0.
inits_guide.EEBLS Tmid Initializer: Set optional_info 'use_eebls_to_initialize_tmid_and_bounds' to y to run a fixed-period box least squares search over the light curve, use the strongest bracketed transit-like signal to initialize Tmid, and narrow the Tmid search range before fitting. Default y.
inits_guide.Pick Comparison by EEBLS SNR: Set optional_info 'pick_comparison_by_eebls_snr' to y to use EEBLS depth SNR as an earlier tie-break when KTMF scores do not settle the comparison-star choice. Default y.
inits_guide.Expected-Value Transit QC: Set optional_info 'use_deviation_from_expected_transit_in_qc' to true to reject transit fits whose fitted Tmid or Rp/R* stray too far from the published expected values. Default true.
inits_guide.Expected-Value Transit QC Sigma: Set optional_info 'deviation_from_expected_transit_in_qc_sigma' to the sigma threshold used by the expected-value transit QC rejection. Default 5.
inits_guide.Assess All Comparisons Before Selecting: Set optional_info 'assess_all_comparisons_before_selecting_best' to y to fit every comparison-star candidate that survives the earlier screening, report all fits, and select the candidate with the highest KTMF score. Default y.
inits_guide.Impact Parameter Fit: Set optional_info 'use_impactparameter_rather_than_inclination_to_fit' to y to sample impact parameter instead of inclination in nested fitting and triangle plots. Default y.
inits_guide.Use PSF Photometry: Set optional_info 'use_psf_photometry' to y to keep PSF photometry in the method search, or n to disable PSF photometry entirely. Default y.
inits_guide.Use Aperture Photometry: Set optional_info 'use_aperture_photometry' to y to keep aperture photometry in the method search, or n to disable aperture photometry entirely. Default y.
inits_guide.Adaptive Apertures: Set optional_info 'use_adaptive_apertures' to true to evaluate aperture candidates in PSF sigma units and rescale the actual aperture/annulus radii frame-by-frame from the measured PSF width. Default false.
inits_guide.Skip Low Comparison Coverage Rejection: Set optional_info 'skip_low_comparison_coverage_rejection' to y to disable EXOTIC's default rejection of comparison stars that are valid in far fewer frames than the rest of the comparison-star field. Default n.
inits_guide.Fit Lightcurve to Every Comparison Candi: Set optional_info 'fit_lightcurve_to_every_comparison_candidate' to y to save one target lightcurve fit plot per comparison star into temp/ using the selected photometry setup. Default n.
inits_guide.Require Comparison Star: Set optional_info 'require_comp_star' to y to require an actual comparison star for the best-fit photometry result.
inits_guide.Target-Driven Comparison Selection: Set optional_info 'Use target-driven comp selection rather than comp-driven comp selection' to y to force the legacy target-driven comparison-star selection path. Default n.
inits_guide.Formatting of null: Due to the file being a .json, null is case sensitive and must be spelled as shown.
inits_guide.Decimal Format: Leading zero must be included when appropriate (Ex: 0.32, .32 or 00.32 causes errors.).
